```python
def compile_plan(entry, module, types, graph):
    order = graph.compile_order(entry)
    declarations = []
    done = set()
    for name in order:
        model = graph.models.get(name)
        if model is None: continue
        for parameter in model.inputs: TypeCollector.collect(parameter.type, declarations, done)
        TypeCollector.collect(model.result.type, declarations, done)
```
